name: Takahagi Ruriko
source:
The heroine of the first story, the protagonist's cousin.

From the protagonist's point of view, Ruriko's family is his "Head Family." The Takahagi family is well-known in the area, its members are bank managers, so they are very wealthy. Born and raised as the only daughter of such a family, Ruriko has the looks and behavior like that of an [i]ojousama[/i]. However──contrary to her appearance, she secretly harbors passionate desires. Since an early age, she sees the protagonist, her cousin, as a "Man."

When her undesired arranged marriage comes up, the lust that has been hidden within her finally overflows.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://argonauts-soft.com/products/ms30/characters_01.html]official website[/url]]
